messages:
Aisha Patel: Hey all — pleased to announce Nora Elbaz is joining Redwood Inference as Senior Manager, Model Onboarding & Performance. Start date Mon Apr 4. Nora will lead cross-functional work to speed onboarding of new open models and own perf signoffs for hosted + dedicated. She reports to Marta Gomez. Please welcome her! :tada:

Marta Gomez: So excited. Nora comes from ScaleAI where she ran model ops for production LLMs. Her focus first 90 days: audit onboarding playbook, set perf SLOs, and ramp the private deploy matrix. Will be scheduling 1:1s — please ping me if you'd like to give input on onboarding gaps.

Samir Rao: Awesome — welcome Nora! Quick ops note: we'll need infra access for model artifacts + a staging pool. @eng-infra can we pre-provision creds? :wave:

Nora Elbaz: Hi everyone — thrilled to join Redwood. Happy to jump on calls this week. My calendar is open afternoon PT. Short background: led model ops at ScaleAI, did a lot of kernel/quantization validation and perf profiling. Looking forward to meeting y'all! :smile:

Leah Chen: Welcome Nora!! Looking forward to partnering on evals and rollout plans. Might ask you about canary thresholds next week.

people-ops-bot: New hire processed: Nora Elbaz added to org chart, Slack, and payroll. Onboarding checklist created at https://redwood-inference.internal/onboarding/1999999000

Marta Gomez: FYI — team intro + pizza at 2pm next Tue in HQ. Remote folks, we'll send Zoom. :pizza:

Samir Rao: Noted. @eng-infra I'll follow up on the staging creds, thanks.

Nora Elbaz: Thanks all — see you Tuesday! :tada:
